referenceUse: Source target/rank only locates an existing retained FDC record. Every destination is reviewed independently; locator identity and rank are never semantic proof.

items.notes: Generic cooking chocolate with no cocoa percentage uses the same retained unsweetened baking-chocolate reference already reviewed for plain/melted cooking chocolate.
